desc.zh: 从逐窗排序到频数树：用区间计数定位中间的出现次数。
desc.en: From sorting windows to a count tree: locate the middle occurrence by interval totals.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space plus O(n-k+1) output

concepts.name: Sliding window median
concepts.description: Count repeated occurrences and average the middle pair for even k.

concepts.name: Count tree rank selection
concepts.description: Use left subtree counts to preserve the desired occurrence rank.
